messages.en:
{07 0d 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Let's get
crackin'!

{07 00 00}What?! {01 00 00 05 00}You don't know what
I'm doing? {07 06 00}Can't you tell by
the way I'm dressed?
{07 15 00}I'm hunting fossils!{01 00 00 05 00}
FO{01 00 00 05 00}SSILS! And you're gonna
help me!
{07 01 00}Quit spacing out, you big
freak sandwich! {01 00 00 05 00}Look alive
and follow me!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}{0b 03 00}{04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 05 00} Hakkame
pihta!

{07 00 00}Mis?! {01 00 00 05 00}Sa ei tea, mida
ma teen? {07 06 00}Kas riietusest
ei ole näha?
{07 15 00}Ma jahin fossiile!{01 00 00 05 00}
FO{01 00 00 05 00}SSIILE! Ja sina
hakkad mind aitama!
{07 01 00}Lõpeta jõllitamine, sa
suur veidrik! {01 00 00 05 00}Ärka üles
ja tule mulle järele!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Hey, you!{01 00 00 0a 00} Hellooooooo?!
Stop daydreaming, you
freakazoid!
{07 06 00}Come help me find a fossil!{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}When I find one, I sell it to
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nook{ff 00 00 00} for huge money!
{07 11 00}We can split the profits
100/0, right? {01 00 00 05 00}Good,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Hei, sina!{01 00 00 0a 00} Hallooooooo?!
Lõpeta unistamine, sa
veidrik!
{07 06 00}Tule aita mul fossiili leida!{01 01 00}
{07 16 00}Kui ma ühe leian, müün selle
{ff 00 00 06}Tom Nookile{ff 00 00 00} suure raha
eest! {07 11 00}Jagame kasumi 100/0,
eks? {01 00 00 05 00}Hea,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Just the other day I found
a fossil! {01 00 00 05 00}Yes, A FOSSIL!!!{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 00 00}But that hypernerd {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 06}Blathers
{ff 00 00 00}told me {07 16 00}it was just a piece
of plastic, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 01 00}Who did it?! {01 00 00 05 00}Who had to go
and shatter my irresistibly
adorable little heart?
{07 05 00}You know what I think?{01 00 00 05 00}
I think it was YOU, you
plastic-fossil SICKO!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Alles hiljuti leidsin ma
fossiili! {01 00 00 05 00}Jah, FOSSIILI!!!{01 00 00 05 00}

{07 00 00}Aga see hüpernohik {01 00 00 05 00}{ff 00 00 06}Blathers
{ff 00 00 00}ütles mulle, {07 16 00}et see oli
plastitükk, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 01 00}Kes seda tegi?! {01 00 00 05 00}Kes pidi
minema ja purustama mu
vastupandamatult armsa
väikese südame? {07 05 00}Tead, mida
ma arvan?{01 00 00 05 00} Et see olid
SINA, sa plastfossiili HAIGE!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Why has it got to be so
hard to find a stupid
fossil? Seriously{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}Right now, I wouldn't mind
digging up a hot spring to
soak in, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Miks peab olema nii
raske leida üht rumalat
fossiili? Tõsiselt{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 06 00}Praegu ei paneks ma pahaks
välja kaevata kuumaallikat,
kus leotada, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}YARRRPZAZZZLEGRAGH!!{01 00 00 05 00}
Why can't I find a single
fossil, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
I bet that snakeface
{04 0c 00} dug 'em all up
already!
{07 06 00}I know you're hiding out
there somewhere, snickering
as I waste my time!
I'll get my revenge!
You hear me, {04 0c 00}? 
This is TOTALLY uncool.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}JARRRPSAKRAAGH!!{01 00 00 05 00}
Miks ma ei leia ühtegi
fossiili, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Kindlasti on see maonägu
{04 0c 00} need kõik juba

{07 06 00}Ma tean, et sa peidad end
kuskil seal ja itsitad,
kui ma oma aega raiskan!
Ma maksan kätte!
Kas sa kuuled, {04 0c 00}?

not sweatin'! {01 00 00 0f 00}Cute girls like

{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
